question: Should ClickClack adopt an optional persistent channel-purpose field as core channel metadata, rather than keeping channel context limited to names, messages, and existing external-management fields?
rationale: The patch is an additive product capability with persistent schema and public SDK implications; correctness evidence alone cannot determine whether that metadata contract belongs in the core product.

options.title: Sponsor the channel-purpose contract
options.body: Accept the optional additive field as core channel metadata once the migration, generated SQL artifacts, and runtime proof are confirmed.

options.title: Keep context outside the core channel record
options.body: Decline the persistent field and direct contributors toward existing channel naming, messages, or a future broader metadata design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the channel-purpose contract
recommendation.body: Accept the optional additive field as core channel metadata once the migration, generated SQL artifacts, and runtime proof are confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the concrete proposed behavior and can provide its implementation and validation context, while a current-main feature owner could not be confirmed here.
